This doc is used to source figures and tables for the [manuscript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CMSp4e_r6As2yim0dHeWNWYWK2msEPtZZl-3ekjgz0I/edit?tab=t.0). File names follow a convention of starting with `fig-` or `tbl-`, then the cross-reference label used in the manuscript draft.

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("results", "setup.R"))
```

```{r}

rerun <- FALSE

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-significance-tests
make_row <- function(name, path) {
  p <- readRDS(here::here("results", path))$p |> unname()
  tibble::tibble(
    indicator = name,
    p_value_close = p[1],
    p_value_near = p[2],
    p_value_moderate = p[3]
  )
}

dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_row("Age", "age_test_bootstrap.rds"),
  make_row("Gini", "pt_bootstrap_Gini.rds"),
  make_row("Low Income", "pt_bootstrap_LI.rds"),
  make_row("Vaccine Hesitancy", "pt_bootstrap_VH.rds")
)
```
